Refill Station

An automated refill station for detergent, dish soap and fabric conditioner. Bring your own bottle and refill it right at your Puregold store.

LESS PLASTIC

CLEAN AND SAFE

Bring your own bottle

Choose detergent, dish soap or fabric conditioner, place your open bottle under the nozzle, and let the station do the rest. Pay at the regular counter.

Three simple parts

1

Choose

Pick your product and the amount you need.

2

Refill

Place your bottle, close the glass door and press start. UV light disinfects, then the machine fills.

3

Pay

Take your bottle and your receipt, then pay at the counter. Scan your Puregold card for points.

See the full process flow
Step by step

Process flow

Follow the 12 steps from scanning your Perks card to paying at the counter. If you need a hand, the HELP button is there for you.

12Steps
3Products
1HELP button
ChoosePrepareRefillFinishHelp
Choose
1
Step 1

Verify your Perks Card

Tap your Puregold Perks card on the reader to collect points. The screen confirms when your card is verified.

2
Step 2

Pick your product

Choose detergent, dish soap or fabric conditioner on the touchscreen.

3
Step 3

Pick the amount

Select how much you need. The price in pesos shows right away.

Prepare
4
Step 4

Place your bottle

Put your open bottle on the platform, close to the nozzle. Remove the cap first.

5
Step 5

Close the glass door

Slide the glass door shut so the bottle stays clean and safe inside.

6
Step 6

Start the refill

Press the START button on the touchscreen to begin.

Refill
7
Step 7

UV light disinfects

UV light cleans the bottle before any liquid goes in.

8
Step 8

Wait for the machine

Your product flows into the bottle. Keep the door closed until it finishes.

9
Step 9

Done!

When the done message appears on the screen, your bottle is ready.

Finish
10
Step 10

Take your bottle out

Open the door and gently take your bottle out.

11
Step 11

Take your receipt

Take the receipt from the slot and bring it to the counter.

12
Step 12

Pay at the counter

Take your receipt to the counter and pay the cashier.

Help
?
Any time

Need help? Press HELP

Press the HELP button at any time. A light on top of the station tells store staff you need assistance.

The prototype

Prototype sketch

Here is how the Refill Station looks from the outside, and what happens inside when you fill a bottle.

OutsideInside

The outside

Everything a shopper touches is on the front panel. Tap the sketch to zoom in.

The figure beside the station shows its size next to a person.

1

Assistance light

A light on top of the station turns on when someone asks for help, so staff can spot it from across the store.

2

Interactive screen

The touchscreen where you pick your product and amount (100 ml, 200 ml or 500 ml) and press start.

3

Card scanner

Tap your Puregold Perks card here to collect points. The receipt slot is right beside it.

4

Assistance button

The red HELP button. Press it any time you are stuck and the light on top comes on.

5

Dispenser

Three nozzles, one each for detergent, dish soap and fabric conditioner. Your bottle goes right below.

6

Tutorial panel

Picture cards on the front show the steps so first-time users can follow along. See the full process flow.

The inside

Left is a 3D cutaway. Right is a flat map of the same parts. The red tag on top is the assistance light.

From tank to bottle

Kiosk machine (red block)The brain. It takes your touchscreen choices and tells every other part what to do.
  1. 1Tank of productYellow tanks in the sketchStores the liquid: detergent, dish soap and fabric conditioner.
  2. 2MachineOrange blocks in the sketchMoves the product from the tank through a hose toward the nozzle.
  3. 3Claw machineBlue chamber in the sketchA claw holds your bottle in place under the nozzle, behind the glass door.
  4. 4Your bottleThe finish lineThe nozzle fills it. When it is done, the screen tells you.
